replication.target_description: Study 1: frontal-midline scalp theta at Fz during day-2 recall, paired CS+N versus CS−N comparison. This is the authors’ electrophysiological replication; AMC source-localized theta was not measured as the same outcome.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing to the within-subject day-2 theta contrast; analytic sample corroborated by the paired-test degrees of freedom.
n.exclusions: 21 recruited; three excluded for complete absence of explicit CS–US contingency awareness after acquisition.

notes: The supplied locators (original p.2&3; replication p.2) do not uniquely identify a statistical contrast and do not locate the full-text Results sections. Selected the nonextinguished CS+ versus CS− contrast because the neutral description specifically names fear expression and the original explicitly labels this contrast as evidence for Hypothesis 1. Related but distinct Contingency × Extinction interaction tests are also printed: original AMC F(1,41) = 8.87, p < 0.005; replication scalp F(1,17) = 6.88, P = 0.018. These interaction statistics are not substituted for the selected paired contrasts. Replication target_match is false under the strict outcome-matching rule because Fz scalp power is a proxy for AMC-localized power. Authors nevertheless explicitly describe their theta finding as a replication. Sources are verified-title full primary PMC HTML, cached read-only after acquisition; locations use exact section and figure rather than unverified PDF page numbers.
